sourceRefs.locator: TGN 7006862, coordinates 50.8500° N, 5.6833° E. These locate the modern city.
Sections Artisanal centre and Trade centre. Glass, pottery, textiles and antler working, and twelve named Maastricht moneyers.
Object description, first paragraph. Found near Thorn in 2009, struck at Maastricht around 625, its two inscriptions and moneyer.

summary.de: Ein Ortsname auf Goldmünzen und archäologische Funde verbinden Maastricht mit mehreren Handwerken.
summary.en: A mint name on gold coins and archaeological evidence connect Maastricht to several trades.
